description: Verify Orders page loads successfully with order-related content
preconditions: Seller is logged in with valid credentials
expected_result: Orders page loads without errors and displays order-related content (Order, PO, Status, etc.)

description: Verify orders list/table is displayed with rows or cards
preconditions: Seller is on Orders page
steps: Scroll down to see the order list
Verify table or card list is visible
expected_result: Orders are displayed in a table or card list format

description: Verify order list shows key columns: Order/PO ID, Status, Date, Amount
preconditions: Seller is on Orders page
steps: Verify at least 2 of: Order, Status, Date, Amount, PO, Quantity, Total headers are present
expected_result: Order list displays at least 2 key column headers (Order, Status, Date, Amount, etc.)

description: Verify search functionality filters orders by keyword
preconditions: Seller is on Orders page
expected_result: Search input filters the order list in real-time

description: Verify order status filter (tabs or dropdown) changes displayed orders
preconditions: Seller is on Orders page
steps: Find status filter tabs or dropdown
Click a status filter (All, Pending, Accepted, etc.)
expected_result: Status filter changes the displayed orders accordingly

description: Verify filtering to show only Pending/Sent orders
preconditions: Seller is on Orders page
steps: Click Pending or Sent filter tab
expected_result: Only pending/sent orders are displayed

description: Verify filtering to show only Accepted orders
preconditions: Seller is on Orders page
steps: Click Accepted or Confirmed filter tab
expected_result: Only accepted orders are displayed

description: Verify clicking an order opens the detail view
preconditions: Seller is on Orders page with at least one order
steps: Wait for detail view to load
Verify order detail content is visible (items, amounts, status)
expected_result: Clicking an order opens the detail view showing order info, items, and amounts

description: Verify order detail view displays the PO/Order number
preconditions: Seller has opened an order detail view
steps: Look for PO or Order number (PO-, ORD-, Order #, etc.)
expected_result: Order detail displays a PO/Order number identifier

description: Verify order detail view shows SKU/item list with quantities
preconditions: Seller has opened an order detail view
steps: Scroll down to see item details
Verify item/SKU details with quantities and prices are shown
expected_result: Order detail shows SKU/item list with quantity, price, and amount details

description: Verify order detail view shows the current order status
preconditions: Seller has opened an order detail view
steps: Look for status indicator (badge, tag, or text)
Verify status is one of: Pending, Sent, Accepted, Packed, Ready, Dispatched
expected_result: Order detail displays the current order status

description: Verify navigating back from order detail to the orders list
preconditions: Seller has opened an order detail view
steps: Click Back button or navigate back
Verify orders list is displayed again
expected_result: Back navigation returns to the orders list successfully

description: Verify Accept button is visible for pending/sent orders
preconditions: Seller is viewing a pending/sent order detail
expected_result: Accept button is visible for orders in Pending/Sent status

description: Verify accepting a pending order transitions its status
preconditions: Seller has a pending order to accept
expected_result: Order is accepted successfully. Status transitions from Pending/Sent to Accepted.

description: Verify Reject button is visible for pending/sent orders
preconditions: Seller is viewing a pending/sent order detail
expected_result: Reject button is visible for orders in Pending/Sent status

description: Verify rejecting an order requires a reason and transitions status
preconditions: Seller has a pending order to reject
expected_result: Order is rejected with a reason. Status transitions to Rejected.

description: Verify Pack action is available for accepted orders
preconditions: Seller has an accepted order
expected_result: Pack action succeeds for accepted orders. Status transitions to Packed.

description: Verify Mark as Ready action is available for packed orders
preconditions: Seller has a packed order
expected_result: Mark as Ready succeeds for packed orders. Status transitions to Ready.

description: Verify Picked Up action is available for ready orders
preconditions: Seller has a ready order
expected_result: Picked Up action succeeds for ready orders. Status transitions to Picked Up.

description: Verify order summary/stats cards are displayed at the top of orders page
preconditions: Seller is on Orders page
steps: Scroll to top of Orders page
Look for stat/summary cards (Total Orders, Pending, Accepted, etc.)
Verify at least one stat is visible
expected_result: Order summary stats (Total Orders, Pending, Accepted, etc.) are displayed

description: Verify pagination controls are present when there are many orders
preconditions: Seller is on Orders page with multiple orders
steps: Scroll to bottom of orders list
Look for pagination controls (Next, Previous, page numbers)
expected_result: Pagination controls are visible when the order list exceeds one page

description: Verify date range filter is available on the orders page
preconditions: Seller is on Orders page
steps: Look for date filter (date picker, date range, Date button)
expected_result: Date range filter is available and clickable without errors

description: Verify the order detail page is scrollable and shows full content
preconditions: Seller has opened an order detail view
expected_result: Order detail page scrolls smoothly with no errors

description: Verify order detail shows a status timeline or history log
preconditions: Seller has opened an order detail view
steps: Scroll down to look for timeline/history
Verify timeline or status history entries are present
expected_result: Order detail shows a timeline or history with status changes (Sent, Accepted, Packed, etc.)
